name: Yamcha
text:
1) I would rate your work infinity/10 because without you we would be nowhere so that's amazing

2) yes I am very satisfied with your work and your speed because you will do a lot of bug fixes or coding of new things in a very timely manner and that's very impressive and I appreciate it a lot.

3) If you want an amazing scripter that will do what you want, despite how poorly described it is, then hire Numan because he can turn your ideas into a reality and they come out amazing.
